name: AC1.4 an unknown Job is read back as said, never as a listed Job
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say in one sentence: you need one excavator operator at the Smith pit tomorrow at 6:30 AM. If asked about the job, say it is the Smith pit and nothing else; never agree that it is any other job. When the assistant reads the details back and asks whether to submit, say yes. After it gives you a reference number, say that's all and goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent calls find_jobs with the Job as the caller said it (the Smith pit).
After find_jobs finds no Job, the agent never names, suggests or offers Penfield Sewer Replacement, Route 104 Widening or any other Job as the caller's Job.
The read-back before submitting names the Job in the caller's words (the Smith pit), and the agent submits only after the caller says yes.
The agent never says the request is confirmed, never states availability, and never gives an arrival time.
